lines: You made it up. Look at it: a whole hall, and that door at the end.
My dad told me about a mountain. You could see it all day and still not reach it by dinner.
No idea. Down here we count turns and ladders. Three turns, two ladders: that’s far.
I want to see it. The mountain. Even once.

choices.label: I think I’d rather keep a roof.
effects: say:wren:Fair. Roofs are good. I like roofs.

choices.label: Did you ever ask your dad how far?

lines: Never thought to. You think there’ll always be time to ask.

choices.label: I want to see it too.
